    • GetImage

      public org.springframework.data.util.Pair<BufferedImage,ArrayList<Rectangle>> GetImage(String filepath)
      Reads an image from the specified file path, applies pre-processing techniques, detects contours in the image, and returns the processed image along with the detected rectangles.
      Parameter:
      filepath - The path to the image file.
      Gibt zurück:
      A Pair containing the pre-processed image as a BufferedImage and a list of Rectangle objects.

    • imagePreprocessing

      private org.opencv.core.Mat imagePreprocessing(org.opencv.core.Mat image)
      Pre-processes the provided image by applying color conversion, CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization), denoising, and adaptive thresholding.
      Parameter:
      image - The image to be pre-processed.
      Gibt zurück:
      The pre-processed image as a Mat object.
